text:
alex_sales: Heads-up — Novabank POC kickoff tomorrow. Need to confirm SSO/SCIM/RBAC scope before we handoff to implementation. Primary asks: SAML IdP integration, SCIM provisioning, domain ownership, and enterprise pricing for Dedicated pool.

maria_se: Got it. Do we have their IdP metadata + example user-schema? Also need to know whether they want groups->roles mapping or attribute-based roles.

emily_novabank: Hi all — we can provide IdP metadata URL and sample SCIM schema. We expect group->role mapping (we have teams mapped to roles). Also need per-route RBAC and tenant isolation for data.

jordan_ts: For SAML: please share metadata XML and confirm SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated. Domain controls: we require DNS TXT for domain claims (org-wide verification or per-domain). For SCIM: which attributes do you use for externalId, userName, emails? If you use custom attributes we'll need a small transform.

sam_security: Security checklist heads-up: 1) SAML cert/key rotation process, 2) SCIM auth (Bearer token vs mTLS) — we recommend mTLS for enterprise but token is ok with a 90d rotation window, 3) Audit logs retention (default 90d; enterprise option 365d), 4) Data residency — confirm target region. Also we'll need the completed security questionnaire (link below) and a minimal SoW clause for SSO/SCIM.

maria_se: Quick SCIM example for mapping groups->roles to use in the POC:
```json
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:ListResponse"],
  "Resources":[{"id":"user-123","userName":"jane.doe","emails":[{"value":"jane@novabank.com"}],"groups":["devops","payments"]}]
}
```
We'll map groups to RBAC roles in the POC: devops->infra-admin, payments->payments-analyst.

alex_sales: Pricing note — they're asking for a committed Dedicated pool estimate for ~100 req/s sustained and ~1M tokens/day. Jordan, can you draft a customer-facing A-side estimate (monthly reserved + overage) we can present? Add pricing caveat for quantization/throughput tuning.

jordan_ts: I will draft an estimate: baseline monthly reserved capacity + tiered overage, include 24/7 support add-on and extended audit logging. Will send numbers later today. For the POC timeline: need IdP metadata and SCIM bearer token by EOD to start config.

emily_novabank: We can get metadata today. Legal needs SSO terms in the SOW before they approve Dedicated budget — can you send a short SOW template with SSO/SCIM clauses?

sam_security: I'll assemble the security QA responses and a minimal SOW clause for SSO/SCIM handling. Note: if they require domain claim verification across 3 separate domains, that will extend onboarding by ~3-5 business days (we need DNS validation and org mapping).

maria_se: Implementation note — for the POC we'll use SP-initiated SAML + temporary SCIM token. We'll enable prefix/KV caching for known org domains to improve latency during load testing. Also remind ops: SCIM provisioning rate limits should be set to 50 req/min for initial sync.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: feature/identity-poc-config -> staging at 2024-10-12T18:30Z :rocket:

alex_sales: Great. Plan: Maria & Jordan to start config, Sam to fill security QA, Jordan to send pricing estimate, Emily to send metadata and SCIM schema. Sync in 24h. :thumbsup:
